searchText: <Arkenan> Hi kamil! We reviewed the modexp perf and we seem to have fixed the issue for the time being. Thanks a bunch for the benchmark analysis! I added this PR to your branch so that the benchmark executes the latest code on our main branch https://github.com/NethermindEth/gas-benchmarks/pull/54 We will likely get our modexp fix merged by today, so if you get our docker image from the `unstable` tag we should be able to see the improvement in the benchmarks too. <FunnyGiulio> what are the current blockers for 60mn gas limit? <FunnyGiulio> now Geth and Erigon both have good modexp times. sorry if redundant, the convo is hard to follow. lots of things being discussed here <KamilChNethermind> re: **@FunnyGiulio** > now Geth and Erigon both have good modexp times. sorry if redundant, the convo is hard to follow. lots of things being discussed here Geth has but introduced regressions so this one is not valid - for some reason tests didn't picked up old version back <FunnyGiulio> oh so geth is missing to the party <FunnyGiulio> once they fix it, is there anything else or can we bring it up to ACDT then? <FunnyGiulio> I think we should aim to do 60mn before Fusaka because it seems like there are plans for a devnet-5 now which *could* delay the timeline further <KamilChNethermind> I think we discussed that and yeah 60 would be great prior Fusaka - other thing is XEN and stateful tests on which we do our best to progress with. Other thing which is needed before 60m is Besu fixes about mod/modarith/binop_simple scenarios from EEST benchmarking which are at 10-15MGas/s now

excerpts.content:
<Arkenan> Hi kamil! We reviewed the modexp perf and we seem to have fixed the issue for the time being. Thanks a bunch for the benchmark analysis! I added this PR to your branch so that the benchmark executes the latest code on our main branch https://github.com/NethermindEth/gas-benchmarks/pull/54

We will likely get our modexp fix merged by today, so if you get our docker image from the `unstable` tag we should be able to see the improvement in the benchmarks too.
